title.zh: 将陆路运输办公室（LTO）达帕区办公室升格为C级LTO区办公室，并更名为锡亚高LTO区办公室，且为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Upgrading the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Dapa District Office Into A Class “C” LTO District Office, Renaming the Same As Siargao LTO District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Upgrading the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Dapa District Office Into A Class “C” LTO District Office, Renaming the Same As Siargao LTO District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật nâng cấp Văn phòng Quận Đáp A của Cơ quan Giao thông Vận tải Đường bộ (LTO) lên thành Văn phòng Quận LTO hạng “C”, đổi tên thành Văn phòng Quận LTO Siargao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติยกฐานะสำนักงานเขตกรมการขนส่งทางบก(LTO)ดาปาเป็นสำนักงานเขตLTOระดับคลาส“ซี”และเปลี่ยนชื่อเป็นสำนักงานเขตLTOซิอาร์เกา

title.ms: Akta Menaiktaraf Pejabat Daerah Dapa Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan Raya (LTO) kepada Pejabat Daerah LTO Kelas “C” dan Menukar Namanya kepada Pejabat Daerah LTO Siargao

text.en: The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) district office in the Municipality of Dapa, Province of Siargao del Norte (LTO Dapa District Office) is hereby upgraded into a Class "C" LTO District Office and renamed as Siargao LTO District Office.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Siargao LTO District Office in the First District of the Province of Surigao del Norte, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the LTO Dapa District Office.
Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continued operation of the Siargao LTO District Office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
